content.short: Dolomite is a decentralized money market and DEX built for lending, borrowing, margin trading, and capital-efficient DeFi.
content.description: Dolomite describes itself as a next-generation decentralized money market protocol and DEX that combines lending and trading inside one modular system. Its docs emphasize broad token support, overcollateralized loans, margin trading, spot trading, flash loans, and a virtual liquidity design aimed at capital efficiency. The protocol is positioned as infrastructure for active DeFi users who want to borrow, hedge, trade, or manage portfolios with more flexibility than a basic lending market. On Mantle, Dolomite fits as an advanced DeFi venue for leveraged strategies, borrowing, and onchain portfolio management.
